name: The Alliance Needs Stranglekelp!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs Stranglekelp!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So, adventurer, did I already tell you about all of the fabulous uses stranglekelp has? I did? Oh well... In any case we need a lot of it, and when I say a lot, I mean A LOT! Do you think that you could help us out? I know that it means going without all of those wonderful things that you can make with it, but it's for a good cause!

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's not true! I'd never skim any stranglekelp off the top of the stacks here. One might be tempted to though considering that it's practically a panacea of utilitarian usefulness. You don't happen to have that stranglekelp we discussed earlier?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hooray! That's another twenty down. You're the best. I suppose that I should get these all packed away before they wither. So much stranglekelp, so little time!
